examples.description: Next 12 months of filing deadlines for a Norwegian AS

description: Compute the upcoming Norwegian regulatory filing calendar for a specific organisation, looking horizon_months ahead. One entry per (obligation, period) pair: a stable obligation_id matching get_company_obligations, the due_date as ISO 8601 in Europe/Oslo (DST-aware), the legal_reference, and recurrence/adjustment flags. Choose this for the calendar view — when does the next MVA / A-melding / Årsregnskap filing land? Inputs: { org_number (9 digits, MOD-11), horizon_months? (1–60) }. Failure modes: NOT_FOUND, VALIDATION_FAILED; a credential without `read:brreg` can't see the tool; a call returns unknown tool (-32602). For the per-obligation verdict, use get_company_obligations instead; for the entity-type-level calendar that needs no organisasjonsnummer (and no API key), use get_public_deadlines instead. No API key? Bearer apier_sandbox_test_<suffix> (fresh suffix) serves synthetic fixtures; org numbers: GET /api/v1/sandbox/fixtures. Cost: 50 øre (NOK 0.50) per call, prepaid (prices: the get_pricing tool or GET /api/v1/pricing; a shortfall returns INSUFFICIENT_CREDITS with top_up_url). Docs: https://www.apier.no/docs/guides/norway-corporate-tax-return-deadline
description_nb: Beregn den kommende innleveringskalenderen for et selskap, `horizon_months` (1–60) frem: én rad per (forpliktelse, periode) med `obligation_id`, `due_date` i Europe/Oslo og `legal_reference`. Krever read:brreg. For vurdering per forpliktelse, bruk get_company_obligations i stedet; for kalenderen uten API-nøkkel, bruk get_public_deadlines i stedet. Kostnad: 50 øre (NOK 0.50) per kall, forhåndsbetalt (priser: verktøyet get_pricing eller GET /api/v1/pricing; for lav saldo gir INSUFFICIENT_CREDITS med top_up_url).

horizon_months.description: Look-ahead window in months (1–60). Omitted → the endpoint's default horizon (12).

org_number.description: 9-digit Norwegian organisasjonsnummer (Brønnøysund ID); MOD-11-checked up-front — a failing value is rejected as VALIDATION_FAILED, so correct the number rather than retrying it.

name: get_company_deadlines

outputSchema.description: Rule 34 envelope; failures set result null + metadata.error_code / retryable / remediation. Contract: https://www.apier.no/docs/mcp

result.description: The upcoming filing calendar: due_date (Europe/Oslo), legal_reference, recurring + business_day_adjusted per obligation×period.
